gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-spline-sans: Wide, tube-like and sharp: Conthrax stacks its tall lowercase almost level with its capitals, while Spline Sans stays sans-serif and approachable, with curves that open generously. Conthrax earns its place big and brief.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of ink, dependable and open. Conthrax towers over it with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, which gives the pair a sharp, futuristic edge against that sans.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif comes across literary and refined, its lowercase oversized and friendly, while Conthrax above it keeps every stroke thick enough to survive glare. Paragraphs would feel warm and bookish.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-port-lligat-slab: Traditional and literary, Port Lligat Slab hugs its letters around wide, porthole-like counters. Make Conthrax small and its tube-like thickness, constant through every bend, would clog up, since that heft wants room to stretch.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-quando: Conthrax runs wide and clean up top, its lowercase a gaping and its strokes tubelike all the way through. Quando sits beneath with sparse, generously spaced text serif letters, giving each word a tall middle zone.
gen-dafont-conthrax-outfit: Conthrax has a wide-mouthed lowercase a and bodies so tall the capitals barely rise above them. It owns the big statement, and Outfit, bent like cable with curves that stop short of closing, handles the sustained reading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is modern and precise, a monoline build whose curve endings stay well apart. And Conthrax, geometric and tall in the lowercase, gives it a bold display voice to follow.
gen-dafont-conthrax-sora: Precise and geometric, Sora lets its curves turn corners without any pressure swell, keeping c and s widely parted. A long stretch would read smoothly, like following a single thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk breathes, its counters like a hollow reed cut open. Its strongest quality is a ribbon of constant width, which sits quietly under Conthrax's tall, geometric, wide-mouthed display letters.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-aleo: Rustic, rugged and wide-spaced: Cowboys sets bold letters with big gaps between stems, all in one laser-etched line. Aleo then brings dignified classic serif counters that let the eye slip in and out, which is the pair's real strength.
